evidence: Emerging technology, including artificial intelligence, offers opportunities to underwrite and price business more efficiently and accurately, thus lowering costs.
Although underwriting and pricing decisions are informed by these analytics, assumptions are required based on experienced judgment
If we cannot use technology and data analytics as effectively as competitors, our competitiveness and ability to write and retain business within our risk appetite will be impacted.
ai_positioning.summary: UFCS envisage l'IA comme un outil interne pour améliorer l'efficacité de la souscription et de la tarification, tout en reconnaissant le risque concurrentiel si elle ne maîtrise pas ces technologies aussi bien que ses rivaux.
